text:
Sounds are made by vibrating objects. A certain object vibrates but a person nearby cannot hear
any sound.
Which statement might explain why nothing is heard?
A
The amplitude of the sound waves is too large.
B
The frequency of the vibration is too high.
C
The sound waves are transverse.
D
The speed of the sound waves is too high.

options.label: A
options.text: The amplitude of the sound waves is too large.

options.label: B
options.text: The frequency of the vibration is too high.

options.label: D
options.text: The speed of the sound waves is too high.
